style.name: Bento grid
style.description: Bento layouts arrange varied content into a modular family of rectangular tiles. Differences in size create hierarchy while shared spacing and alignment keep the collection coherent.

fonts.heading: DM Sans
fonts.rationale: Clean sans-serif forms help short tile headlines and compact supporting details form a consistent system.

tips: Give every tile one clear purpose.
Use tile size to express content importance.
Plan the reading order before the mobile stack.
avoid: Packing unrelated material into one tile.
Relying on desktop position to explain relationships.

recipe.composition: Use unequal modules in a stable grid; each tile has one purpose and a deliberate reading priority.
recipe.motion: Animate a changed tile's content rather than moving the entire grid.
recipe.signature: Modular composition, varied tile scale, and a coherent palette across independent content.
